reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Expanding support to malaria control interventions in high priority districts of Pakistan - Pakistan (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Pakistan, Malaria, Directorate of Malaria Control, Ministry of National Health Services, Regulations and Coordination of Pakistan (DoMC/CMU Malaria)This program has the following goals: By 2020, reduce the malaria burden by 20% in 66 high endemic districts/agencies (Stratum-I) of Pakistan. The objectives of this program are: To ensure and sustain universal coverage of multiple prevention to population at risk in target districts by 2020. To ensure and sustain > 80% coverage for the provision of quality assured early diagnosis and prompt treatment services to population at risk in target districts by 2020. To increase community awareness upto 80% on the benefits of early diagnosis, prompt treatment and Malaria preventive measures using health promotion, advocacy and BCC interventions by 2020. To ensure availability of quality assured strategic information (epidemiological, entomological and operational) for informed decision making. To enhance technical and managerial capacities of malaria control programs in planning, implementation, management and M&E
